item.title: Nagoya Women's Marathon: The World's Largest Women's Race — Guide
item.description: The Nagoya Women’s Marathon, run each year on a Sunday in early March, is recognised as the world’s largest women-only marathon, bringing some 20,000 runners from around the globe onto a flat, fast course that loops from Nagoya Dome past Nagoya Castle, the Sakae skyline and the city’s broad avenues. The race is famous for its finisher’s reward — an exclusive Tiffany & Co. pendant handed over by tuxedoed presenters — and for the city-wide festival mood, with cheering squads, taiko teams and a running expo that make marathon weekend one of Nagoya’s liveliest.
